funding_code: REAP IRA RES GRANT UNRESTRICTED (FY 25)
naics_industry_sector: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting
project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to help Oxford Horse & Cattle Ranch, a horse and cattle operation in Laramie, Wyoming, install a ground-mounted solar array system. The system will help power freezers for processed beef, hot water, and electricity for a barn and outbuildings on the property. This project is expected to save the agricultural operation $4,724 per year. It will replace 39,360 kilowatt hours (kWh), or 61 percent of the company's current annual energy use, which is enough energy to power approximately four homes.

funding_code: REAP RENEWABLE ENERGY SYSTEM (RES) GRANT UNRESTRICTED AMOUNT
naics_industry_sector: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting
project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to help Michael Boulter install a 15 kilowatt (kW) wind turbine to reduce electrical costs of his pasture lease operation. The business is located outside of Rock River, Wyoming. The new system will generate 40,228 kilowatt-hours (kWh), an annual savings valued over $2,600. The wind turbine will replace 100 percent of the current energy usage and is enough energy to power approximately four homes.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to provide additional financing for the development of community water and sewer infrastructure improvements and the replacement of the Great Plains sewer lift station for the Northern Arapaho Housing Authoritys Chief Black Coal housing project. The housing project intends to construct 20 single-family homes and a small community building in Fremont County. The 10-acre site for the 20 new homes currently has no drinking water or waste water infrastructure in place. project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to provide equipment for the Northern Arapaho Tribe Solid Waste Program (NATSWP), replacing older equipment that has reached its useful life. The project will allow NATSWP to increase the number of waste program users, also increasing revenue and sustainability. This investment will help combat the many illegal dumping sites on the Wind River Reservation.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to construct a new critical access hospital and clinic to serve the Platte Valley community and surrounding areas in Southern Wyoming. Hundreds of coal miners have been laid off in the Gillette, Wyo. area, and these educational opportunities create a significant asset to the state-wide economy by developing and retaining certified welders for potential employers.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development loan guarantee investment will be used towards expansion costs at Wyoming Custom Meats in Hudson, Fremont County, Wyo. This family-owned business opened in 2007; and they are expanding their facility due to increasing demand for locally produced high quality meat products. Wyoming Custom Meats currently processes and sells Wyo. raised livestock products to local residents and restaurants. This loan will allow them to market products across the US, internationally and offer online sales. In addition to traditional meat products, they produce and sell sausages, jerky, smoked and barbequed products and specialty products such as pig knuckles. Through this financing with First Interstate Bank in Riverton, Wyo. this project will create three jobs. Local ranchers will benefit by receiving a premium price for their beef processed at Custom Meats. USDA loan guarantee programs bolsters the availability of private credit for rural small businesses, and meet the Presidents implementation for the Task Force on Agriculture and Rural Prosperity.
